name: Bridal Clutch
hook: Clutch a 1v1 against your fiancée or remain permanently single at the altar
tagline: Sweat in your rented tuxedo as bridesmaids set up smoke grenades and flashbangs down the aisle. Cash out early to secure the ring and escape on a golf cart. Crash out when your bride executes a 360 noscope headshot while the priest yells GG.
